title: Water Tank Empty
shortDescription: Humidifier has run out of water.
fullDescription: E1 shows when the tank is empty or water level too low for operation. Refill and reseat.

title: Filter Clean Required
shortDescription: Wick or evaporative filter needs cleaning.
fullDescription: E2 prompts to clean or replace the filter. Mineral buildup reduces output.

title: High Humidity Reached
fullDescription: E3 or blinking icon means the room has reached or exceeded set humidity. Unit pauses.

fixSteps.title: Adjust target
fixSteps.instruction: Lower target or leave - unit resumes when humidity drops.

title: Humidity Sensor Error
fullDescription: E4 means the sensor is not reporting valid data. Power cycle first.

title: Fan Error
fullDescription: E5 indicates fan not reaching commanded speed. Unplug, inspect for blockage.

fixSteps.title: Inspect
fixSteps.instruction: Look for debris in fan housing.

title: Scale Build-up
fullDescription: SC reminder appears periodically to descale the water chamber.

fixSteps.title: Descale
fixSteps.instruction: Use vinegar solution per manual, rinse.

faq.a: Plain white vinegar; avoid cleaning vinegars with soap.

title: Wi-Fi Disconnected
fullDescription: WF means Wi-Fi lost. Re-pair via app.

title: Child Lock
fullDescription: LC indicates child lock. Hold lock button 3 seconds.
